digo: Muuyu (also healers' name: Mkulu kazingwa); muuyu (tree); uyu (fruit); mbuyu (seed/pod); healers' name mkulu kazingwa
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III (Muuyu); Pakia (2005) App. VI (Mkulu kazingwa, healers' name); also Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Muuyu); Mgombato; ICRAF ('Digo: Muuyu'); Pakia

teaser.en: Healers call the baobab 'the great one who is never betrayed', because as a medicine it is said never to fail.
teaser.sw: Waganga huuita mbuyu 'mkubwa asiyesalitiwa', kwa sababu kama dawa inasemekana haushindwi kamwe.
teaser.dg: Aganga anauiha muuyu 'mkulu kazingwa', mkulu ambaye kasalatwa, kpwa sababu nkugombwa kukala dza dawa taushindwa kabisa.

summary.en: *Muuyu* is the baobab, the great swollen-trunked tree of the coastal plain that can live for thousands of years. It feeds, heals and shelters the Digo, and stands beside the sacred meeting place at the heart of the kaya.
summary.sw: *Muuyu* ni mbuyu, mti mkubwa wenye shina lililovimba wa nyanda za pwani unaoweza kuishi kwa maelfu ya miaka. Huwalisha, huwaponya na huwapa Wadigo kivuli, na husimama kando ya mahali patakatifu pa mikutano katikati ya kaya.
summary.dg: *Muuyu* ni muhi mkulu wa tsi ya photsi ya pwani wenye kolo ririrovwimba, na unaweza kukala na moyo kpwa maelufu ga miaka. Unarisa Adigo, unaaphoza na unaapha pepho, na unaima kanda-kanda ya phatu takatifu pha kuonana kahi ya kaya.

about.en:
Nothing else on the coast looks like *muuyu*. Its grey trunk swells to as much as six metres across, and for much of the year the tree stands bare, its stubby branches spread like roots in the air.

The leaves, when they come, are divided like an open hand. The large white flowers hang on long stalks and open at night. They give way to velvety, oval pods filled with chalky, dry white pulp around hard seeds.
about.sw:
Hakuna kitu kingine pwani kinachofanana na *muuyu*. Shina lake la kijivu huvimba hadi kufikia upana wa mita sita, na kwa muda mrefu wa mwaka mti husimama bila majani, matawi yake mafupi na manene yakiwa yametandaa kama mizizi angani.

Majani yanapochipuka, hugawanyika kama kiganja kilichokunjuliwa. Maua makubwa meupe huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu na huchanua usiku. Baadaye huzaa makaka ya mviringo yenye ngozi kama ya mahameli, yaliyojaa unga mkavu mweupe kama chaki unaozunguka mbegu ngumu.
about.dg:
Takuna chitu chanjina pwani chinachohalana na *muuyu*. Kolore ra rangi ya ivu rinavwimba hadi kufika upana wa mita sita, na kpwa unji wa mwaka muhi unaima bila makodza, na pandaze fupi zinatandazika dza mizi iriyo dzulu hewani.

Makodza, ganaphokpwedza, ganaganyika dza mkpwono uriovuguka. Maruwa makulu mereru ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire na ganavuguka usiku. Bada ya maruwa kuna makakaya ga mviringo-mrefu genye manyoya-nyoya, ganagodzala unga mkavu wa rangi nyereru dza chokaa kuzunguluka tembe ngumu.

where.en: Baobabs grow throughout the coastal plain in bushland, on farmland and around the edges of the kayas, and they are common in Kwale. They also stand in villages, often far older than the settlements around them. They are easiest to pick out in the dry season, when the bare grey giants stand out against the bush.
where.sw: Mibuyu hustawi katika nyanda zote za pwani, vichakani, mashambani na pembezoni mwa kaya, na ni mingi Kwale. Pia husimama vijijini, mara nyingi ikiwa ya zamani sana kuliko makazi yanayoizunguka. Ni rahisi zaidi kuitambua wakati wa kiangazi, majitu hayo ya kijivu yasiyo na majani yanapojitokeza dhidi ya kichaka.
where.dg: Miuyu inamera kosi kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani, weruni, mindani na kanda-kanda ya makaya, na ni minji Kwale. Piya inaima kpwa vidzidzi, na kpwa kawaida ni ya kare sana kuriko midzi iriyo kanda-kanda yao. Ni rahisi zaidi kuimanya wakati wa kazikazi, wakati mihi mikulu ya rangi ya ivu isiyo na makodza inaonekana wazi kahi ya weruni.

uses.en:
The dry pulp is eaten raw or dissolved in water to make a sour drink or sauce. The seeds are fried, and coloured, sugar-coated seeds, *mabuyu*, are sold as sweets. Young leaves are cooked as a vegetable.

The inner bark gives fibre for rope, baskets and string, and hollow trunks are used to store water.

Bark, roots, leaves and fruit are all used in medicine. The Digo of Diani boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria, and healers use the tree to 'cool down' problems.
uses.sw:
Unga mkavu huliwa mbichi au huyeyushwa katika maji kutengeneza kinywaji au mchuzi wenye ukali wa uchachu. Mbegu hukaangwa, na mbegu zilizotiwa rangi na kupakwa sukari, *mabuyu*, huuzwa kama peremende. Majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga.

Gamba la ndani hutoa nyuzi za kutengenezea kamba, vikapu na uzi, na mashina yenye mvungu hutumika kuhifadhia maji.

Gamba, mizizi, majani na matunda yote hutumika katika dawa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kama tiba ya malaria, na waganga hutumia mti huu 'kupoza' matatizo.
uses.dg:
Unga mkavu nkuriwa vivyo au nkuyeyuswa madzini kuhenda chinwadzi cha ngbwadu au mtsuzi. Tembe nkukalangwa, na tembe zirizotiywa rangi na sukari, *mabuyu*, nkuguzwa dza peremende. Makodza matsanga nkujitwa dza mtsunga.

Gopha ra ndani rinalavya nyuzi za kuhendera kamba, kaphu na lugbwe, na makolo ga ndani matupu nkuhumirwa kuikira madzi.

Gopha, mizi, makodza na matunda gosi nkuhumirwa dza dawa. Adigo a Diani nkujita makodza dza dawa ya homa (malaria), na aganga nkuhumira muhi uhu 'kuphoza' matatizo.

culture.en: Healers know the baobab as *mkulu kazingwa*, 'the great one is never betrayed': as a medicine, it never fails. In the Digo kayas, the *moroni*, the elders' meeting place, is described as lying between a fig tree and a baobab. A Digo proverb runs: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'My husband has roasted for a baobab so that he can eat its mushrooms', meaning that both the man and the tree gain from the deal.
culture.sw: Waganga huujua mbuyu kama *mkulu kazingwa*, 'mkubwa hasalitiwi': kama dawa, haushindwi kamwe. Katika kaya za Wadigo, *moroni*, mahali pa mikutano ya wazee, panaelezwa kuwa kati ya mkuyu (mti wa jamii ya mtini) na mbuyu. Methali moja ya Kidigo inasema: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'Mume wangu amechoma moto kwa ajili ya mbuyu ili ale uyoga wake', ikimaanisha kwamba mwanamume na mti wote wawili wananufaika na mapatano hayo.
culture.dg: Aganga anaumanya muuyu dza *mkulu kazingwa*, 'mkulu kasalatwa': dza dawa, taushindwa kabisa. Kpwa makaya ga Adigo, *moroni*, phatu pha kuonana pha azehe, nkugombwa kukala phakala kahi ya mkuyu (mgandi) na muuyu. Ndarira ya Chidigo inagomba: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'Mlume wangu waochera muuyu ili arye wogawe', manage ni kukala mlume na muhi gosi mairi anaphaha fwaida.

names.en: The tree is *muuyu*, the fruit *uyu* (plural *mauyu*), and a seed or seed pod *mbuyu* (plural *mauyu*). Healers use the name *mkulu kazingwa*. Swahili calls the tree *mbuyu* and the seeds *ubuyu* or *mabuyu*. Giriama also says *muuyu* (fruit *mauyu*), while Chonyi says *muyu*. In English it is baobab.
names.sw: Mti ni *muuyu*, tunda ni *uyu* (wingi *mauyu*), na mbegu au kaka la mbegu ni *mbuyu* (wingi *mauyu*). Waganga hutumia jina *mkulu kazingwa*. Kiswahili huuita mti *mbuyu* na mbegu *ubuyu* au *mabuyu*. Kigiriama pia husema *muuyu* (tunda *mauyu*), huku Kichonyi kikisema *muyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *baobab*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *muuyu*, tunda ni *uyu* (wingi *mauyu*), na tembe au kakayare ni *mbuyu* (wingi *mauyu*). Aganga anahumira dzina *mkulu kazingwa*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi unaihwa *mbuyu* na tembe *ubuyu* au *mabuyu*. Kpwa Chigiryama piya unaihwa *muuyu* (tunda *mauyu*), na kpwa Chichonyi *muyu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *baobab*.

conservation.en: The baobab is not threatened, and individual trees can live for around 3,000 years.
conservation.sw: Mbuyu hauko hatarini, na mti mmoja mmoja unaweza kuishi kwa takriban miaka 3,000.
conservation.dg: Muuyu tauri hatarini, na muhi mmwenga-mmwenga unaweza kukala na moyo kpwa miaka phephi 3,000.

reason.en: A fig; the kaya meeting place lies between a fig and a baobab
reason.sw: Mti wa jamii ya mtini; mahali pa mikutano ya kaya ni kati ya mtini na mbuyu
reason.dg: Mkuyu; phatu pha kuonana pha kaya pha kahi ya mkuyu na muuyu

reason.en: Close relative in the same family, the kapok tree
reason.sw: Ndugu wa karibu katika familia moja, msufi
reason.dg: Ndugu wa phephi wa jamii mwenga, msufi

reason.en: Another sour fruit pulp made into drinks
reason.sw: Tunda jingine lenye unga wa uchachu unaotengenezwa vinywaji
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra ngbwadu rinalohendwa vinwadzi

reason.en: Another big fig of the kaya forests
reason.sw: Mti mwingine mkubwa wa jamii ya mtini katika misitu ya kaya
reason.dg: Mkuyu wanjina mkulu wa matsaka ga kaya

reason.en: Another swollen, softwood tree of the dry bush
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wenye shina lililovimba na mbao laini wa vichaka vikavu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wenye kolo ririrovwimba na nyama za muhi za yuya, wa weruni kavu

definition.en: A baobab seed or seed pod.
definition.sw: Mbegu au kaka la mbegu la mbuyu.
definition.dg: Tembe au kakaya ra tembe za muuyu.

mgombato: mbuyu2 (mauyu) baobab seed or seed pod; mbuyu. (See: muuyu, uyu)

muuyu (mi) baobab tree (Adansonia digitata); mbuyu. Proverb: Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye. My husband has roasted for a baobab so that he can eat its mushrooms. (Both the man and the tree benefit from this.) (See: uyu)
uyu (ma) fruit of the baobab tree; mbuyu. (See: muuyu)
